name: Al-Sahra Tires
description: Providing reliable and durable tires built for performance.
story: Al-Sahra Tires is a new venture focused on bringing quality, locally manufactured tires to the global market. Motorsport is a key testing ground for their technology, and they are looking to partner with up-and-coming teams to prove their products on the track and build brand awareness. They value reliability and a strong work ethic.
